name: heading
label: Heading
default: See who's available before you post

name: subhead
label: Subhead
default: Every profile shows trades, experience and how far away they are.

name: cards
label: Cards
help_text: Example cards: workers (Company page) or jobs (Job Seeker page). Static: they don't update from the app.

children.name: worker
children.label: Title
children.help_text: Worker mode: name · trade. Job mode: company · job title.

children.name: score
children.label: Value, top right
children.help_text: Worker mode: profile score (92%). Job mode: pay ($23/HR). Shown in green. Leave empty to hide.

name: score_label
label: Value label
help_text: Under the green value: "Profile score" or "Compensation".

name: note
label: Note under the cards
default: Get instant notifications of new matches and applicants

name: mode
label: Card type
help_text: Worker: a company's view of a worker (button sends a job). Job: a worker's view of a job post (button applies). Changes the screen-reader wording of the button.

name: spacing
label: Spacing
help_text: Gap between heading, subhead, cards and note. Large 64 px (Company frame), Small 32 px (Job Seeker frame).
